title: Placement: Armstrong Number
description: An Armstrong number (or Narcissistic number) is a number that is equal to the sum of its own digits each raised to the power of the number of digits. Given an integer `n`, return `True` if it is an Armstrong number, and `False` otherwise.
solution:
def is_armstrong_number(n: int) -> bool:
    s = str(n)
    power = len(s)
    return sum(int(ch) ** power for ch in s) == n
explanation: Count total digits K. Compute the sum of each digit raised to power K. If sum equals n, it is an Armstrong number.
